title: Analysis of AAV serotypes 1-9 mediated gene expression and tropism in mice after systemic injection
readout: whole-animal luciferase plus organ vector genomes and protein
key_use: Same-cassette head-to-head natural-serotype baseline; AAV9 broadest; AAV4 lung and kidney; AAV6 heart liver muscle
major_limit: Single sex and mouse-only; promoter and assay affect apparent tropism

title: Positron emission tomography imaging of novel AAV capsids maps rapid brain accumulation
key_use: Separates early blood/capsid PK and shows PHP.eB brain uptake in permissive mice
major_limit: PHP.eB depends on mouse Ly6a background and does not directly translate to primates

title: Quantitative Whole-Body Imaging of I-124-Labeled Adeno-Associated Viral Vector Biodistribution in Nonhuman Primates
key_use: Closest-species quantitative early organ distribution and half-life source
major_limit: Very small animal count; radiolabel signal is capsid fate rather than functional transduction

title: Whole-Body Disposition and Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic Modeling of Adeno-Associated Viruses and the Transgene Product
readout: vector DNA plus transgene product with PBPK fitting
key_use: Mechanistic PBPK benchmark linking tissue vector PK to intracellular processing and expression
major_limit: Only two capsids and a secreted antibody cassette; fitted receptor terms are not universal

title: A novel approach to quantitate biodistribution and transduction of adeno-associated virus gene therapy using radiolabeled AAV vectors in mice
key_use: Direct multi-organ early time courses used for AAV9 apparent half-life fits
major_limit: Dual labels measure tracer-associated capsid/catabolite fate rather than expression persistence

title: A comprehensive atlas of AAV tropism in the mouse
readout: organ qPCR plus ZsGreen and Cre-tdTomato imaging
key_use: Ten-capsid 22-tissue head-to-head atlas with sex effects
major_limit: A mouse atlas; permanent Cre labeling and qPCR answer different biological questions

title: A comprehensive study of AAV tropism across C57BL/6 mice BALB/c mice and crab-eating macaques
readout: barcoded vector DNA and RNA plus histology
key_use: Best current cross-strain and cross-species comparison for LK03 PHP.eB CAP-B10 rh10 and AAV1-AAV9
major_limit: Pooled-library competition; NHP immune suppression and pre-existing antibodies; RNA depends on CAG cassette

title: Mapping administration route-dependent transduction profiles of commonly used AAV variants in mice by barcode amplicon sequencing
key_use: Demonstrates that capsid preference must be conditioned on route; includes PHP.eB and lung-targeted AAV2-ESGHGYF
major_limit: Pooled-library mouse study; IV/IP results cannot be transferred directly to IT ICM or human

title: ZOLGENSMA US prescribing information
readout: clinical dose plus shedding qPCR and two-patient postmortem biodistribution
key_use: Clinical context for 1.1e14 vg/kg dose; liver-dominant human vector DNA with broad tissue detection
major_limit: Product payload age disease and postmortem sampling differ from the reference-adult model

title: Interindividual variability in transgene mRNA and protein production following AAV gene therapy for hemophilia A
readout: liver biopsy vector DNA episome RNA and protein
key_use: Direct human evidence that transcriptionally competent liver episomes persist for multiple years
major_limit: Small biopsy substudy; AAV5 FVIII cassette and liver-specific context do not identify a universal decay half-life

title: Recombinant AAV vector genomes take the form of long-lived transcriptionally competent episomes in human muscle
readout: muscle biopsy vector genomes molecular forms and expression
key_use: Direct human evidence for multiyear circular episome persistence in skeletal muscle
major_limit: Local IM AAV1 and muscle biopsy results do not calibrate systemic AAV9 delivery

title: Death after high-dose rAAV9 gene therapy in a patient with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
readout: postmortem qPCR ddPCR tissue vector genomes and transgene analysis
key_use: Human AAV9 observation supporting liver-high distribution and showing substantial lung and heart genomes
major_limit: Single fatal case with severe disease and high-dose investigational product; not a normal PK time course
